ingredients.nom: Condensed cream of broccoli or cream of mushroom soup

technique_de_realisation: In a sauté pan over medium heat, cook onion, celery and thyme in hot margarine until onion is tender.
In a 12 x 8 inch baking dish, combine turkey and cooked vegetables. Add soup mixture, stirring gently.
Unroll crescent rolls. Firmly press perforations and cut dough lengthwise into 8 strips about 3/4 inch wide.
Arrange dough strips over chicken mixture to form a lattice, cutting strips as needed. Press ends of strips to baking dish.
Cover edges with foil after 20 minutes if pastry browns too quickly.
Cook at 375 F for 30 minutes or until golden. Let stand before serving.
